title: [dynamo] Port CPython 3.13 test_string to Dynamo
body:
## Summary
Part of #196238

Ports CPython 3.13 `test_string` to run under `torch.compile` via `CPythonTestCase`.

- Copied pristine module from CPython v3.13.5
- Prepended the Dynamo patch header and rebound `unittest.TestCase` to `CPythonTestCase`
- No bytecode / `_testcapi` / gc skips were needed
- Recorded 35 Dynamo expected failures under `test/dynamo_expected_failures/`
- Regenerated `test_string.diff` with `tools/regenerate_cpython_diffs.py`

Passing (3): `ModuleTest.test_attrs`, `ModuleTest.test_capwords`, `ModuleTest.test_vformat_recursion_limit`.

Shared failure causes:
- `string.Formatter` tests hit C builtins `_string.formatter_parser` and `_string.formatter_field_name_split`
- `string.Template` tests hit `re.Pattern.sub` with a non-constant convert callback

## Test plan
- [x] `PYTORCH_TEST_WITH_DYNAMO=1 python test/cpython/v3_13/test_string.py -v` on Python 3.13 (3 passed, 35 expected failures)
- [x] `python tools/regenerate_cpython_diffs.py --check --only test_string.py`
